findings.title: Same-commit master-ledger rule is mechanically enforced by a filename heuristic
findings.detail: validate_same_commit_rule scans only files under docs/architecture/reviews/evidence/ ending in .json whose name contains 'real-execution-result'. A future advancing event result banked under any other name or directory would evade the mechanical git rule (probe RT-11). Additionally, the numeric guards accept bool for 'ledger_after' and 'consumed_reads' (isinstance(x, int) admits bool), and the rule only checks that the v2 ledger file changed in the same commit, not that its content incorporates the new event.

findings.title: Bound-value comparison uses Python cross-type equality
findings.detail: The resolver compares resolved != expected with Python ==, under which True == 1 and 175 == 175.0 (probe RT-12). A bound JSON field whose type drifts from integer to float or bool at the same numeric value would still pass, although the SHA-256 byte pin on every bound file makes silent drift impossible without a contract update. All nine current bound/adapter declarations resolve to exact-type integers or strings.
